description: Get available addons for a specific shipping product. Returns addons like insurance, cash on delivery (COD), delivery to company/private person, non-standard items, and other supplements. Each addon includes pricing, category, requirements, and validation rules. Use this after selecting a product from search_products to see available options. IMPORTANT: Do NOT guess or assume country IDs. Always call get_countries first, find the matching country by name or ISO code, and use the value from its 'id' field as the country ID.
name: get_product_addons
